title: تفتان — پاکستان کا شہر، ایران کے آتش فشاں کے نام پر

facts: Taftan is the headquarters town of Taftan District, Balochistan; one of Pakistan's border crossings with Iran (Iranian side: Mirjaveh)
Over 500 km from Quetta by road or rail; on the N40
62 km north-east of the thermally active peak also called Taftan, which lies wholly in Iran
Served by Koh-e-Taftan railway station on the Quetta-Taftan line, which since 1940 continues to Zahedan, Iran

style_block: Mixed-media hand-cut PAPER COLLAGE, editorial zine style with Balochi embroidery and truck-art accents. Torn and scissor-cut paper edges, masking-tape corners, halftone print dots, old map clippings, railway tickets, real paper drop shadows. Figures are PRINTED-texture halftone cut-outs, not CGI, not a 3D render, keep print grain. Palette: desert sand, rust red, mustard, dark brown. Vertical 9:16 poster, flat scanned lighting. No text in the image. Keep the bottom quarter simple.

keyframes.keyframes/k1.png: SCENE as layered paper cut-outs: a lone desert volcano peak cut from an old engraving, wisps of paper steam rising from its summit, a torn paper map with a dotted border line and a question mark stamp. Bold flat rust-red background.
keyframes.keyframes/k2.png: SCENE as layered paper cut-outs: a small desert border town with a gate, trucks decorated with Pakistani truck-art patterns, a border fence line, two paper flags as plain colour shapes (green-white and green-white-red, no emblems). Bold flat mustard background.
keyframes.keyframes/k3.png: SCENE as layered paper cut-outs: a long highway ribbon and a railway track crossing a sand-colour paper desert, a vintage steam train, a milestone stone, a vintage railway ticket. Bold flat desert-sand background.
keyframes.keyframes/k4.png: SCENE as layered paper cut-outs: the volcano peak again seen across a border fence, a paper ruler measuring the distance between a small town and the mountain, glowing orange paper vents. Bold flat dark brown background.
keyframes.keyframes/k5.png: SCENE as layered paper cut-outs: a 1940-style steam locomotive pulling carriages across the border, an old calendar page cut-out, a railway signal, a station board with no readable text. Bold flat rust-red background.
keyframes.keyframes/k6.png: SCENE as layered paper cut-outs: two signposts pointing in opposite directions, one toward a small town, one toward a volcano, a puzzled camel cut-out between them, scattered paper stars. Bold flat mustard background.

beats.script: پاکستان کا ایک شہر || ایک آتش فشاں کے نام پر ہے۔ || اور وہ آتش فشاں || *ایران* میں ہے۔
یہ ہے *تفتان* || بلوچستان میں || پاکستان اور ایران کی سرحد پر۔
کوئٹہ سے *<500|پانچ سو>* کلومیٹر سے بھی زیادہ دور۔ || سڑک سے بھی، || ریل سے بھی۔
اور اصل کوہِ تفتان؟ || سرحد کے پار، || *<62|باسٹھ>* کلومیٹر دور، || ایک گرم اور جاگتا ہوا پہاڑ۔
یہاں کی ریلوے لائن || *<1940|انیس سو چالیس>* سے || ایران کے شہر *زاہدان* تک جاتی ہے۔
تو اگلی بار کوئی پوچھے || تفتان کہاں ہے؟ || تو پوچھیے: || *کون* سا تفتان؟
